derivation.observed_vs_derived: Concurrency and output-token count are recorded recipe values. Constant full occupancy and one call per step are the declared scenario, not an observed complete scheduler trace.
derivation.rule: All 64 requests are already admitted and contribute exactly one token to each of 1024 decode calls. Weight counts calls, not requests times calls.

excluded: partial admission and changing decode batch size
scope: One KDA layer at one TP8 rank; fully admitted 64-request decode scenario only.
